unsupported_claims.why_unsupported: The brief states the capacity safeguard and routing constraints but does not prescribe this exact internal ordering or define a distinct eligibility-decision component.

verdict.strongest_transmitted_behavior: The failover and failback safety sequence is transmitted exceptionally well: detect full home-region loss, pause checkout while carts and catalog remain available, require quorum lease plus lag within RPO, promote before changing DNS/edge, resume the outbox, then rejoin the recovered region as a read replica, catch up and validate it, apply shadow traffic, and treat writer return as a separate controlled operation.
verdict.most_consequential_loss: The largest loss is operational classification and dependency detail around the control plane: the reconstruction does not preserve the distinct instance, availability-zone, regional-service, database-write, and full-isolation failure classes, and it largely omits control-plane distribution and regional expiry of configuration, feature flags, signing keys, and service identities. Several data relationships—especially catalog-to-document-store, cart-to-KV consistency, and exact cross-region event paths—also require inference.
verdict.overall_summary: The board communicates the complete architecture shape, primary customer routing and commerce path, atomic order/outbox persistence, payment idempotency and provider alternatives, single-writer promotion gates, degraded checkout behavior, and controlled failback. An engineer could conduct a productive design and failover review from the reconstruction. Fidelity falls short of implementation-level completeness because multiple secondary but meaningful relationships and constraints are compressed or absent: per-customer home-region selection, concurrent cart-update detection, exact replica topology, detailed failure taxonomy, dead-letter triggers, configuration and identity distribution, and complete audit-event coverage. There is no contradiction of a system-defining flow or failure outcome, so no rubric cap applies.
